jp: この宇宙は苦難で満ちているのです。私と一緒に…少しでも楽な方へと堕ちていきませんか？
jp_grezzo: "この宇宙は苦難で満ちているのです。私と一緒に…少しでも楽な方へと堕ちていきませんか？"

en_grezzo: "This universe is full of suffering. I can take you to a nicer place, an easier life... Won't you come with me?"
it: Questo universo trabocca di sofferenza. Perché non sprofondi insieme a me... verso qualcosa anche solo un pochino più facile?

jp: ふふふ…♪もうこの宇宙には戻ってこれませんけど、構いませんよね？さぁ、一度そっと目を閉じて。…そして開いて、私の瞳孔を見つめるのです。
jp_grezzo: "ふふふ…♪もうこの宇宙には戻ってこれませんけど、構いませんよね？さぁ、一度そっと目を閉じて。…そして開いて、私の瞳孔を見つめるのです。"
en: Fufufu... You're okay with leaving this universe behind forever? Good, good. Now, look into my eyes...
en_grezzo: "Fufufu... You're okay with leaving this universe behind forever? Good, good. Now, look into my eyes..."
it: Uffufu...♪ In questo universo non potrai più tornare, ma non ti dispiace, vero? Su, chiudi piano gli occhi, una volta sola. ...E poi riaprili, e guarda dentro le mie pupille.

jp: アハァ♪わかりますよ、ええわかりますとも。物足りないのでしょう？さぁ、倍率を迷う必要なんてありません。どうせ、遅かれ早かれ最終的には最大倍率を選ぶのですから。
jp_grezzo: "アハァ♪わかりますよ、ええわかりますとも。物足りないのでしょう？さぁ、倍率を迷う必要なんてありません。どうせ、遅かれ早かれ最終的には最大倍率を選ぶのですから。"
en: Aha~... Yes, yes, I understand. You must not be satisfied with your current, slow pace. Would you like something faster? Come, let go of your inhibitions and tell me what you desire...
en_grezzo: "Aha~... Yes, yes, I understand. You must not be satisfied with your current, slow pace. Would you like something faster? Come, let go of your inhibitions and tell me what you desire..."
it: Ahaa♪ Lo so, sì, lo so benissimo. Non ti basta, vero? Su, non c'è nessun bisogno di esitare sul moltiplicatore: prima o poi finirai per scegliere il massimo comunque.

jp: ん～？これで本当にいいんですかぁ？
jp_grezzo: "ん～？これで本当にいいんですかぁ？"
en: Hmm...? Is that really enough for you?
en_grezzo: "Hmm...? Is that really enough for you?"

jp: 欲望の解放にブレーキをかけているのですね。かわいい～♪

jp: 中途半端が一番体によくないものです…。選び直さなくていいんですか…？

en_grezzo: "Leaving things halfway? That's no good. Wouldn't you like to pick a better option?"
it: Le cose a metà sono quel che fa peggio al corpo... Non vuoi ripensarci...?

jp: 「昔はそうだったから」セーフなんですよね？でも今は更に上があるんですよ？
jp_grezzo: "「昔はそうだったから」セーフなんですよね？でも今は更に上があるんですよ？"
en: \"It should be safe since that's how it used to be\", eh? But are you really satisfied knowing that there's now an even higher level?
en_grezzo: "\"It should be safe since that's how it used to be\", eh? But are you really satisfied knowing that there's now an even higher level?"
it: \"Una volta era così, quindi va bene\", eh? Ma adesso c'è anche di più, sai?

jp: いいんですよ…自分自身で選んだ快楽で、頭おかしくなっちゃいましょうねぇ♪

en_grezzo: "It's okay, don't worry. Enjoy the pleasure you've chosen for yourself. Go crazy..."

en_grezzo: "Of course. Here, how many do you want? I'll give you all that you desire. And when that is no longer enough, come back and I'll give you even more..."

jp: さぁ、どうぞ？ちなみに最低経験値1なら、何か経験値が入るたびにそのステータスが最低1レベルアップすることになります。潜在が足りなくても関係ありませんから、思う存分ステータスを上げられますよ。うふふふふ！良かったですねぇ。
jp_grezzo: "さぁ、どうぞ？ちなみに最低経験値1なら、何か経験値が入るたびにそのステータスが最低1レベルアップすることになります。潜在が足りなくても関係ありませんから、思う存分ステータスを上げられますよ。うふふふふ！良かったですねぇ。"

It doesn't matter if you don't have enough potential - you can raise your status as much as you want. Ufufufufu! Sounds like a good time, doesn't it?

It doesn't matter if you don't have enough potential - you can raise your status as much as you want. Ufufufufu! Sounds like a good time, doesn't it?"
it: Su, prego? Ah, e con l'esperienza minima a 1, ogni volta che entra dell'esperienza quell'attributo sale almeno di un livello. Il potenziale non conta più niente, quindi puoi alzare gli attributi quanto ti pare. Uffufufufu! Che bella cosa, eh.

jp: 1ずつ上がる程度ならセーフ？どこまでがセーフかなんて、気持ち次第じゃありませんか？

en_grezzo: "So you feel safe just improving your skills one level at a time, huh? But are you really satisfied knowing that you can keep improving even faster?"
it: Salire di uno alla volta sarebbe \"sicuro\"? Ma fin dove sia sicuro dipende da come ti senti, non credi?

jp: 適度な苦難こそが人を成長させる…そして、苦難を乗り越えなければ得られない悦びもある…。ええ、わかっていますとも。頭ではわかっていても…私の身体がわかってくれないのです。
jp_grezzo: "適度な苦難こそが人を成長させる…そして、苦難を乗り越えなければ得られない悦びもある…。ええ、わかっていますとも。頭ではわかっていても…私の身体がわかってくれないのです。"

en_grezzo: "I already know. Just right difficulties will make people grow. And there are pleasures that can not be gained unless you overcome difficulties..."
it: Una giusta dose di fatica è quel che fa crescere le persone... e ci sono gioie che non si ottengono se non la si supera... Sì, lo so bene. Ma anche se la testa lo capisce... il mio corpo non vuole capirlo.
